definitions: A relationship in which a person, thing, or idea is linked or associated with something else.
A link or bond between two or more things.
A means of transport that allows passengers to transfer from one service to another.
A person or organisation that can provide useful contacts or services.
examples: The connection between diet and health.
There is a strong connection between the two events.
I missed my connection in London.
He has connections in high places.
